Body.Content:
Network analytics updates are rolling out in Microsoft Viva Engage, giving corporate communicators and network admins more flexibility to analyze activity and engagement across their organization.

With this update, network analytics includes custom date ranges, faster activity data refreshes, updated dashboard and metric table designs, expanded organizational filters with search, and new people-manager filters for viewing direct reports or full reporting hierarchies. These enhancements make it easier to explore trends, understand audience engagement, and measure communications impact across the network.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/viva/engage/analytics-organizational-data-filtering

GA date: December CY2026
